BOOK ONE · LESSON 097

A small blue case

一只蓝色的小箱子

A dialogue lesson on possessive pronouns. Mr. Hall has left a suitcase on the train to London and goes to the lost property office to claim it. He describes it as a small blue case with a zip and a label on the handle. The attendant finds a matching case, checks the name and address on the label (D. N. Hall, 83, Bridge Street), and charges him three pounds fifty pence. But when Mr. Hall opens the case, it does not belong to him — the attendant has given him the wrong case. New vocabulary includes leave, describe, zip, label, handle, address, pence, and belong. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions on the dialogue and describing items at a lost property office. Grammar exercises practise possessive pronouns (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs), fill in the blanks with possessive adjectives or pronouns, and make sentences using 'belong to'.

Listen to the recording and answer the question: Does Mr. Hall get his case back?

  1. 1

    MR. HALL

    I left a suitcase
    on the train to London
    the other day.

    霍尔先生：几天前我把一只手提箱忘在开往伦敦的火车上了。

  2. 2

    ATTENDANT

    Can you describe it, sir?

    服务员：先生，您能描述一下它是什么样子的吗？

  3. 3

    MR. HALL

    It's a small blue case
    and it's got a zip.
    There's a label on the handle
    with my name and address on it.

    霍尔先生：是只蓝色的小箱子，上面有拉链。箱把上有个标签，上面写着我的姓名和住址。

  4. 4

    ATTENDANT

    Is this case yours?

    服务员：这箱子是您的吗？

  5. 5

    MR. HALL

    No, that's not mine.

    霍尔先生：不，那不是我的。

  6. 6

    ATTENDANT

    What about this one?
    This one's got a label.

    服务员：这只是不是？这只箱子有个标签。

  7. 7

    MR. HALL

    Let me see it.

    霍尔先生：让我看看。

  8. 8

    ATTENDANT

    What's your name and address?

    服务员：您的姓名和住址？

  9. 9

    MR. HALL

    David Hall,
    83, Bridge Street.

    霍尔先生：大卫·霍尔，大桥街83号。

  10. 10

    ATTENDANT

    That's right.
    D. N. Hall,
    83, Bridge Street.

    服务员：那就对了。D. N. 霍尔，大桥街83号。

  11. 11

    ATTENDANT

    Three pounds fifty pence, please.

    服务员：请付3英镑50便士。

  12. 12

    MR. HALL

    Here you are.

    霍尔先生：给您。

  13. 13

    ATTENDANT

    Thank you.

    服务员：谢谢您。

  14. 14

    MR. HALL

    Hey!

    霍尔先生：嗨！

  15. 15

    ATTENDANT

    What's the matter?

    服务员：怎么回事？

  16. 16

    MR. HALL

    This case doesn't belong to me!
    You've given me the wrong case!

    霍尔先生：这箱子不是我的！您给错了！

New words & expressions 生词和短语

leave /liːv/
v. 遗留
describe /dɪˈskraɪb/
v. 描述
zip /zɪp/
n. 拉链
label /ˈleɪbl/
n. 标签
handle /ˈhændl/
n. 提手，把手
address /əˈdres/
n. 地址
pence /pens/
n. penny 的复数形式
belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/
v. 属于

Notes on the text 课文注释

the other day

the other day, 几天前。

It's got a zip.

句中的 it's = it has, 不是 it is。

Is this case yours?

这箱子是您的吗？其中的 yours 是表示所有格的代词，所有格代词不能用于名词之前，在句中一般要重读。

83, Bridge Street

大桥街 83 号。在英文中书写地址时，要把门牌号放在街名的前面。

Hey!

感叹词，用来表示惊讶、疑问或用以引起注意。
